query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.sponsorId,
  sp.companyName as sponsorName,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.matchScore,
  m.delegateId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors sp ON m.sponsorId = sp.id
WHERE m.isVisible = 1 AND m.timeSlot IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.sponsorId, m.timeSlot
LIMIT 300;
